notes: Name: In his 1835 birth entry he is registered under his Jewish name, Hirschel Löbel. Moravian Jews at the time commonly had a Jewish name (used in synagogue and often in the registers) and a German name for civil life, usually chosen to sound like it or share its first letter. Hirsch/Hirschel/Herschel was very commonly rendered as Heinrich (Löbel/Löw usually as Leopold). By the 1860s, when his own children were registered, families used the German names, so as an adult he appears as Heinrich. The match rests on: father Bernard Mondschein, the same household (house no. 144), and a birth date consistent with his age (53) at death in 1888.
Death date: Geni gives 6 Aug 1888; the Kyjov death register (kn 939) gives 26 May 1888, aged 53, used here.

(Gruntovní kniha židovských domů 19–155, SOkA Hodonín, AM Kyjov, Nro. 144 Brantweinhaus, fol. 151v–152 | 1860: "nach der am 16. März 1855. verstorbenen Fanni Mondschein, wird das Eigenthumsrecht für die erblasserischen Söhne: Mondschein Heinrich und Gerson beide minderjährig im Werthe zu 6575. Gulden österr. Währ. einverleibt." | "Gemäß des Kaufvertrages d. Gaya am 22. Juli 1859. geschlossen zwischen Rudolf Kämpf und den am 7 Juli 1859 N. 3895 et 4332 für großjährig erklärten Brüdern Heinrich und Gerson Mondschein, wird auf dieses Brantweinhaus und den Keller fol. 110. das Eigenthumsrecht für Kämpf Rudolf in Kunewald um den Preis zu 5775 Gulden österr. Währ. einverleibt.", eingetragen 24. September 1860)

Birth year: the 20 Apr 1848 birth previously recorded here belongs to her sister Jetti (Henriette); the 1848 entry (kn 932, p. 7) reads 'Jetti Redlich'. Netti's age at marriage in May 1862 (22 y 4 m) puts her birth about Jan 1840; Geni gives 1839.

Derselbe hat das Eigenthum dieses Judenhauses auf Grund der Schenkungs?urkunde seines Vaters Bernard Mondschein dto 1. intab. 5. Oktober 1833. N. 1492. Jud. erworben im Werthe von … Conv. 400. Vide U. L. Tom II. fol. 266. et pr." | 1833: Schätzungsurkunde dto 19. Oktober 1833 N. 1540, Werth 322 | Dawid Herschl Sonnenschein "hat dieses Judenhaus laut des Kontrakts dto 8. Februar intab 2. April 1842. N. 549. Jud. von Mathias Mondschein erkauft um … Conv. 500" | Basis for his parentage: father = Gerson Bernard, owner of house 150 since 1800, d. 1835; mother not named.)

Parentage research: House 150 in Gaya was bought by Bernard Mondschein from the Jewish community on 7 Sept 1800, given to Mathias by deed of his father Bernard on 1 Oct 1833, sold by Mathias to David Herschel Sonnenschein in 1842, and bought by Nathan Redlich in 1846. Mathias still lived at house 150 when he married in 1838, and moved to house 19, bought 1842-43. His father is therefore Gerson Bernard Mondschein, c.1767-1835, not Bernard junior, who was born 1798. This fits his Familianten entry Nachgeb., a later-born son, and his trade as a flour dealer like Gerson Bernard in 1807. The deed does not name his mother; Verona is assumed. The births of Mathias Mandl, 22 Jun 1806, son of Moyses Mandl, and Mathias Moritschek, 23 May 1807, son of Benedikt, are not his; Mathias Mareczek is also absent from Benedikt's 1837 heirs.
